title: Mesh Community Information Schema
description: A schema for the unified directory of community information for local mesh networks, including Meshtastic and MeshCore

nullableString.description: A string that can also be null

geocoordinate.description: A geographic coordinate, either latitude or longitude

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp representing a point in time

meshtastic_mqtt_topic.description: An MQTT topic string, following Meshtastic convention (e.g. msh/US/CO/#)

psk.description: Pre-shared key for the channel, encoded in base64

hw_region.description: Hardware region for the channel (e.g. US915, EU868)

summary.description: Description of the channel's purpose and usage

meshcore_region_code.description: Short code for the region used in MeshCore repeater configurations. This can be used to restrict repeaters to only traffic from specified regions

code.description: A MeshCore channel code, which is a public channel prefixed with a pound sign (#)

summary.description: Description of the MeshCore channel's purpose and usage

latitude.description: Latitude of the region's center point

longitude.description: Longitude of the region's center point

radius_km.description: Radius of the region in kilometers, defining a circular area around the center point

geo.description: Geographical information about the region, used for mapping and spatial queries

meshtastic_mqtt_topics.description: MQTT topics associated with this region

meshtastic_channels.description: Meshtastic channels associated with this region.

meshcore_region_code.description: Short code for the region used in MeshCore channel codes (e.g. 'co' for Colorado, which would be used in a MeshCore channel code like #co-weather)

meshcore_public_channels.description: Public MeshCore channels associated with this region.

sub_regions.description: Nested sub-regions within this region. This can represent, e.g. cities within a county, or neighborhoods within a city.

code.description: Short code for the country (e.g. US)

regions.description: Array of regions within the country.

meshcore_node_id.description: First 2 bytes of the MeshCore node public key

meshcore_node_public_key.description: Public key for the MeshCore node

meshcore_contact_uri.description: A MeshCore contact URI for the node, which can be used to add the node as a contact in MeshCore (e.g. 'meshcore://contact/add?name=NodeName&public_key=0100...&type=2')

properties.$comment: The properties 'type' and 'id' should also be here

id.description: First 2 bytes of the MeshCore node public key, used as a short identifier for the node (e.g. '0100')

public_key.description: Public key for the MeshCore node

name.description: Name of the MeshCore node, e.g. 'Downtown Repeater'

last_heard.description: When the node was last heard from

owner.description: Contact information for the owner of the node, if available (e.g. an email address or social media handle)

contact.description: A MeshCore contact URI for the node, which can be used to add the node as a contact in MeshCore (e.g. 'meshcore://contact/add?name=NodeName&public_key=0100...&type=2')

params.description: Additional parameters for the node, which can include any extra information not covered by the other properties. This is a free-form object that can contain any key-value pairs relevant to the node.

regions.description: List of region codes that this node is associated with. This can be used to link the node to specific regions defined in the directory, and can also be used for filtering nodes by region.

schema_version.description: Version of the schema, via semantic versioning

directory_version.description: Version of the directory data, via semantic versioning or date-based versioning

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 date and time when the directory was last updated

summary.description: A description of the directory and its purpose

countries.description: List of countries in the directory, each with their own regions and associated information

nodes.description: List of MeshCore nodes in the directory
